assumptions.load_bearing_because: The partition fixes parallelism, review dependencies and the number of independently counted attempts.

proposal.proposal: Evaluate a successor queue that partitions by dependency and observed service time after Wave A; do not repartition or delay the active Wave A.

assumptions.reason: The shape satisfies the 64-unit floor and covers all ten functions, but committed evidence contains no executed alternative partition and no completed or independently reviewed outcomes. Adequacy is evidenced; optimality is not.
assumptions.statement: Seventy-four units in ten fixed cohorts is the right partition for Wave A.

test.method: Count units by function and cohort and search the committed ledger for outcome evidence that compares this partition with another.

assumptions.load_bearing_because: Changing writer cardinality could trade custody safety for speed.

proposal.proposal: Retain a singleton authority for final promotion while simulating sharded verification and content-addressed fan-in as throughput alternatives.

assumptions.reason: The committed mechanism uses one controller as a safety boundary around shared mutable state. No PARENT_INGESTED event exists, so the claim that it is already a measured throughput ceiling is unsupported.
assumptions.statement: The single integration controller should be treated primarily as a throughput ceiling.

test.method: Inspect committed ownership and control-plane code for the controller's enforced responsibility, then inspect the ledger for measured integration throughput.

assumptions.load_bearing_because: Provider-loss recovery and immutable read-back depend on the selected sink.

proposal.proposal: Measure git read-back, callback-loss recovery and batching against an in-memory message-only baseline without changing the active durable sink.

assumptions.reason: Git is the commissioned sink and the emitter encodes immutable commit locators, but this committed ledger snapshot has no result commit or ingestion. Compliance is implemented; recovery and throughput superiority are not yet observed.
assumptions.statement: Git remote custody is empirically the right durable result sink for this workload.

test.method: Check committed code for git-backed result locators and count durable result events in the committed ledger.

assumptions.load_bearing_because: Every append, projection and recovery scan depends on the ledger's integrity and access cost.

proposal.proposal: Benchmark checkpointed chain segments and cohort shards while preserving an immutable global head and the current JSONL as the active source of truth.

assumptions.reason: The 148-row chain is valid, which supports integrity. The implementation re-reads and re-hashes the full history on each append, implying quadratic cumulative verification work; no substrate comparison establishes that this remains the right scale choice.
assumptions.statement: One hash-chained JSONL file is the right ledger substrate at Wave A scale.

test.method: Independently verify every committed row and inspect append_event for full-history verification before each append.

assumptions.load_bearing_because: Blind review and successor claims rely on the freeze being behavioural, not ceremonial.

proposal.proposal: Keep freeze ordering as a safety control, but reserve any behavioural-effect claim for the registered matched comparisons and independent dispositions.

assumptions.reason: The wave preregisters tests of criteria freezing, but there are no ACCEPTED or REJECTED events and no matched behavioural outcome in the committed snapshot.
assumptions.statement: Freezing acceptance criteria changes reviewer behaviour and reduces escaped defects.

test.method: Identify preregistration units and count committed terminal review outcomes in the same ledger snapshot.

assumptions.load_bearing_because: Allocation determines heterogeneous cognition, review independence and claimed strongest-model use.

proposal.proposal: Retain exact current assignments for continuity and use per-model dispositions plus matched evaluations before claiming work-class fit or changing allocation.

assumptions.reason: Every allocated slug is observed as exposed and exact slugs are frozen, but role fit is asserted rather than measured: no accepted result, defect attribution or matched model comparison exists in this snapshot.
assumptions.statement: The model allocation is well matched to each work class.

test.method: Join exact dispatched model slugs to observed exposure and search committed outcomes for per-model acceptance or defect evidence.

assumptions.load_bearing_because: Acceptance hashes are only meaningful if every source named by the dispatch still has the frozen content.

proposal.proposal: Add a read-only source-capsule verifier that reports CURRENT, DRIFTED and MISSING before material execution; do not rewrite immutable dispatch records.

assumptions.reason: The immutable dispatch record remains unchanged, but path-ownership.json changed after dispatch. The current emitter verifies the manifest reference, not source-byte closure, so a valid result can describe work executed against drifted control input.
assumptions.statement: Referencing an immutable dispatch-manifest hash is sufficient to ensure workers execute the frozen source bytes.

test.method: Re-hash every source path in immutable dispatch a9-u01 and compare it with the hash frozen before dispatch.

assumptions.load_bearing_because: Parallel writers are safe only if their accepted outputs cannot contend for the same path.
assumptions.reason: No subordinate prefix equals or contains another subordinate's prefix in the committed ownership register. This upholds structural collision isolation, not end-to-end ingestion success.
assumptions.statement: Disjoint subordinate ownership prefixes remove direct worker-to-worker path collisions.

test.method: Compare every subordinate owned prefix against every other subordinate prefix for equality or nesting.

evidence_policy: Only bytes in the current committed baseline are treated as evidence; absence of a completed outcome is NOT_YET rather than inferred success.
